instructions.name: cancel_unfunded_ax
docs: Close a fully unfunded Ax draft; rent to user_a (initiator).

instructions.name: create_ax_split
docs: Same as `create_ax`, but with explicit per-leg platform fees (fee_a / fee_b),
each in that leg's fee asset (SOL/SPL for fungible legs, SOL lamports for NFT legs).

types.name: AssetType
docs: Solana asset kind supported by TrustLayer escrow + Ax.

fields.name: settlement_fee_bps
docs: Legacy single-rate metadata; non-authoritative for Ax, especially split-fee deals.

fields.name: settlement_fee_amount
docs: Legacy single-fee metadata; non-authoritative for split Ax deals (see per-leg fields).

fields.name: settlement_fee_a
docs: Per-leg fee: same asset as leg if fungible; SOL lamports if NFT leg.

fields.name: fee_source_leg
docs: 0 = fee on A, 1 = fee on B, 2 = split both legs.

fields.name: both_funded_at
docs: Set once when both legs first become funded. Ax expiry clock starts here.

fields.name: disputed_at
docs: Set when open_dispute_ax succeeds.

fields.name: expiry_duration_seconds
docs: Seconds after both_funded_at until party release expires (from create inputs).

fields.name: cancellation_fee_bps
docs: Always 0 — TrustLayer does not charge cancel fees.

fields.name: fee_payer
docs: Who economically pays settlement fee (and refund fee source).

fields.name: sol_fee_locked
docs: SOL lamports locked for NFT platform fee (0 for fungible).

fields.name: cnft_nonce
docs: Leaf id / nonce for cNFT; 0 if N/A.

fields.name: cnft_tree
docs: Merkle tree id for cNFT; default if N/A.

fields.name: nft_asset_id
docs: Asset id / data hash placeholder for cNFT/pNFT client verification.

types.name: FeePayer
docs: Who bears settlement fee economically.

constants.name: DEFAULT_CANCELLATION_FEE_BPS
docs: Cancellation fee: 0.2% (20 bps). Unfunded cancel may still be free off-chain policy.

constants.name: MIN_ESCROW_DURATION_SECONDS
docs: Optional minimum gap when a deadline timestamp is still supplied
at create time. 1-leg deadline is metadata only — it does NOT block party release. Ax expiry duration starts when both legs are funded.
